method.inspector: Codex assistant visual inspection; not a human artist-resemblance evaluation
method.coverage: All 398 matched source reproductions visually inspected across 16 numbered contact sheets; 90 candidate edge cases enlarged across 23 contact sheets. Each raw SHA-256 byte-verified before inspection. Reference visual classes recorded before consulting original title-derived content labels; development content was not classified. No model scores were consulted.
method.crop_method: Manual conservative rectangular coordinates selected from orientation-corrected source previews. Genuine signatures and irregular original unpainted canvas edges retained. Ambiguous edge shadows and two nonrectangular frame cases left unchanged. For slightly oblique sources, a bounding rectangle may retain a small frame sliver to preserve painting content. Cropped short sides are all at least 512 raw pixels.
method.crop_visual_qa: All 58 proposed cropped source previews were visually checked in three additional numbered contact sheets. No painted composition or genuine signature was intentionally removed. Residual narrow frame wedges or cast shadows remain where conservative rectangular bounds preserve the painting edge.
